titolo: Australian universities expand ChatGPT access to train AI‑native graduates
descr: Universities in Australia are integrating ChatGPT into curricula to prepare students for an AI‑enabled workforce.
paragrafi: Australian higher‑education institutions are increasing the availability of ChatGPT for students.
The move aims to embed artificial intelligence tools directly into teaching and learning processes.
Universities say the initiative will help graduates develop skills needed in an AI‑driven job market.
Expanding AI access aligns with broader efforts to modernise education and meet industry demand for AI‑savvy talent.
perche: Students gain hands‑on experience with leading AI models, improving employability in AI‑focused roles. Educators can leverage free tools like ChatGPT to enhance instruction without relying on costly proprietary solutions.
